annotations.title: Edit a LinkedIn ad (copy, landing page, button, lead form)

description: Edit a LinkedIn ad (creative) in place: its copy (text), landing page, button (callToAction), its name, or — while it is still DRAFT — the lead gen form it opens (leadFormId) and that button’s label (leadButton). Copy, landing page and button live on the ad’s sponsored post and are edited there. An ACTIVE ad needs confirm:true because real people see the change on the next impression, and LinkedIn may review it again. Status is NOT changed here — use set_linkedin_ads_status. Everything is read back from LinkedIn. Free.

adAccountId.description: LinkedIn ad account id shared with this profile; needed only when several are shared

callToAction.description: button label on the ad; needs a landing page on the ad

confirm.description: REQUIRED true to edit an ACTIVE ad

landingPage.description: new click destination, full https URL

leadButton.description: lead gen button label; only while the ad is DRAFT

leadFormId.description: DRAFT creatives only — the lead gen form the ad opens

name.description: creative name shown in Campaign Manager
